themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for aggressive border controls and externalized migration processing, with multiple national movements rallying around third-country deportation models like the Rwanda framework. Rhetoric across Spain, Sweden, Norway, and the UK increasingly links housing and welfare access strictly to national priority.
